theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ζ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ψs : ℕ → DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) (φs : ℕ → TestFormOn U k), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → (∀ l, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (ψs l)) → (∀ l x, (φs l : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x = ζ x • ψs l x) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ l in atTop, ∀ x ∈ tsupport ζ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (ψs l) x‖ ≤ ε) → TestFormOnConverges φs 0
